ctx.x: Rex Stewart, okay, I'm sorry. And he tried to (inaudible) rehearsal, said, good. The next thing I know Dave Page got his notice. And I was blamed for it because Duke is hanging out with me. And we get in the station, train station, and Charlie Fulton. They were with Basie (inaudible). He's whispering about me, how dirty I was, what I did to Dave Page, and I don't know nothing.

But when this thing got to going so far, and what I tell you with the Curly Hammonds and the Versewis Harrison and Leroy the Ballet, and they all got real gangsterized over there, I says, time to leave.
When I left to form my band, the first man I had on trumpet was Dave Page.
